findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vulnerability_info, vulnerability_score, vulnerability_search, feed_report_catalog, feed_report, purl_audit, advisory_info, cwe_info, package_info, product_vulnerabilities, vulnerability_history · Private data: sightings_search, vulnerability_info, vulnerability_search, purl_audit, vulnerability_exploits, vulnerability_history · Public sink: vulnerability_score, purl_audit, kev_check · Destructive: epss_timeseries, feed_report, package_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vulnerability_info, vulnerability_score, vulnerability_search, feed_report_catalog, feed_report, purl_audit, advisory_info, cwe_info, package_info, product_vulnerabilities, vulnerability_history · Private data: sightings_search, vulnerability_info, vulnerability_search, purl_audit, vulnerability_exploits, vulnerability_history · Public sink: vulnerability_score, purl_audit, kev_check · Destructive: epss_timeseries, feed_report, package_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
